description: Which x402 API should I call? API recommendation and x402 discovery. Required: need= (the task in plain words). Returns up to 5 ranked paid endpoints with URL, price, network, method, the seller's example body, risk flags and evidence: we challenged each one and it answered 402, plus real payer and repeat counts. Never recommends our own endpoints. No match = 404 with near misses, not charged. Deterministic, no model. $0.01 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

limit.description: Same as max, accepted under this name too.

max.description: How many candidates to return, 1 to 5. Default 3. Alias: limit.

maxPrice.description: Optional ceiling in USD per call, for example 0.01. Candidates above it are dropped. Alias: max_price_usd.

max_price_usd.description: Same as maxPrice, accepted under this name too.

need.description: The task, in plain words. Scored against the name, tags, description and URL of every verified endpoint in the index.
